lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhae puneet har teerath naaiaa ||26||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are purified, bathing in the sacred shrine of the Lord. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar saa(n)t hai man tan naam samaai ||
lines.translation: Within the Gurmukh is peace and tranquility; his mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamo chitavai naam paRai naam rahai liv laai ||
lines.translation: He contemplates the Naam, he studies the Naam, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paaiaa chi(n)taa gaee bilaai ||
lines.translation: He obtains the treasure of the Naam, and his anxiety is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai naam oopajai tisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam wells up, and his thirst and hunger are completely relieved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai paai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, he gathers in the Naam. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਜਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh j maariaa bhram bhramiaa ghar chhod gaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who is cursed by the True Guru, abandons his home, and wanders around aimlessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਜੈ ਫਕੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: os pichhai vajai phakaRee muhu kaalaa aagai bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is jeered at, and his face is blackened in the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅਰਲੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟਦਾ ਮੁਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: os aral baral muhahu nikalai nit jhagoo sutadaa muaa ||
lines.translation: He babbles incoherently, and foaming at the mouth, he dies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਦੈ ਕੀਤੈ ਜਾਂ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa hovai kisai hee dai keetai jaa(n) dhur kirat os daa eho jehaa paiaa ||
lines.translation: What can anyone do? Such is his destiny, according to his past deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai ohu jaai tithai ohu jhoothaa kooR bole kisai na bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Wherever he goes, he is a liar, and by telling lies, he not liked by anyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਜੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vekhahu bhaaee vadiaaee har sa(n)tahu suaamee apune kee jaisaa koee karai taisaa koee paavai ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, behold this, the glorious greatness of our Lord and Master, O Saints; as one behaves, so does he receive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ehu braham beechaar hovai dar saachai ago de jan naanak aakh sunaavai ||2||
lines.translation: This shall be God's determination in His True Court; servant Nanak predicts and proclaims this. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਬਧਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sachai badhaa thehu rakhavaale gur dite ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has established the village; the Guru has appointed its guards and protectors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨ ਰਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran hoee aas gur charanee man rate ||
lines.translation: My hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is imbued with the love of the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਹਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kripaal bea(n)t avagun sabh hate ||
lines.translation: The Guru is infinitely merciful; He has erased all my sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur apanee kirapaa dhaar apane kar lite ||
lines.translation: The Guru has showered me with His Mercy, and He has made me His own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਇਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sad balihaar jis gur ke gun ite ||27||
lines.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has countless virtues. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਲੇਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee rajaai lekhiaa paai ab kiaa keejai paa(n)de ||
lines.translation: By His Command, we receive our pre-ordained rewards; so what can we do now, O Pandit?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਤਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ਹੰਢਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਮਾਂਦੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hukam hoaa haasal tade hoi nibaRiaa ha(n)dhahi jee kamaa(n)de ||1||
lines.translation: When His Command is received, then it is decided; all beings move and act accordingly. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਕਿ ਨਥ ਖਸਮ ਹਥ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧਕੇ ਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nak nath khasam hath kirat dhake de ||
lines.translation: The string through the nose is in the hands of the Lord Master; one's own actions drive him on.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਦਾਣੇ ਤਹਾਂ ਖਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa daane tahaa(n) khaane naanakaa sach he ||2||
lines.translation: Wherever his food is, there he eats it; O Nanak, this is the Truth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਥਾਟਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਓਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe galaa aap thaat bahaaleeon ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself puts everything in its proper place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape rachan rachaai aape hee ghaalion ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself destroys it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape ja(n)t upaai aap pratipaalion ||
lines.translation: He Himself fashions His creatures, and He Himself nourishes them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daas rakhe ka(n)th laai nadar nihaalion ||
lines.translation: He hugs His slaves close in His embrace, and blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagataa sadaa ana(n)d bhaau doojaa jaalion ||28||
lines.translation: O Nanak, His devotees are forever in bliss; they have burnt away the love of duality. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man har jee dhiaai too ik man ik chit bhaai ||
lines.translation: O mind, meditate on the Dear Lord, with single-minded conscious concentration.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keeaa sadaa sadaa vadiaaeeaa dei na pachhotaai ||
lines.translation: The glorious greatness of the Lord shall last forever and ever; He never regrets what He gives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau har kai sad balihaaranai jit seviai sukh paai ||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord; serving Him, peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahai haumai sabad jalaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains merged with the Lord; he burns away his ego through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sevaa laaian aape bakhas karei ||
lines.translation: He Himself enjoins us to serve Him, and He Himself blesses us with forgiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa kaa maa piu aap hai aape saar karei ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the father and mother of all; He Himself cares for us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaain tin nij ghar vaas hai jug jug sobhaa hoi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abide in the home of their inner being; they are honored throughout the ages. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karan kaaran samarath hahi karate mai tujh bin avar na koee ||
lines.translation: You are the Creator, all-powerful, able to do anything. Without You, there is no other at all.
